label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value 'bar' is attacker-controlled because it is derived from 'param', which is assigned the request parameter name ('name') if the corresponding value equals 'BenchmarkTest00541'. Parameter names are user-supplied via HTTP request. Alert 2 (java/tainted-format-string): alert-TP — resolved sink value 'bar' is attacker-controlled and used as the format string argument in PrintWriter.format(), allowing potential format string injection. Both alerts indicate real vulnerabilities.

evidence.note: User input flows from request.getParameterNames() into 'param' variable based on parameter value equality.
'bar' is assigned a Base64-decoded version of 'param', preserving user-controlled data.
'bar' is passed to response.getWriter().format() as the format string argument, enabling XSS and format string attacks.
